def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # The shapes are repeated small diagonals. Connect pairs of opposing arms
    # that lie on the same row or column, using 1 as the connector.
    # Horizontal: find neighboring V centers with their side points in one row.
    for r in range(h):
        xs=[c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==2]
        for a,b in zip(xs,xs[1:]):
            # separated opposing arm endpoints; only link if each is part of a V
            left = (r>0 and a>0 and grid[r-1][a-1]==2) or (r+1<h and a>0 and grid[r+1][a-1]==2)
            right = (r>0 and b+1<w and grid[r-1][b+1]==2) or (r+1<h and b+1<w and grid[r+1][b+1]==2)
            if b-a>=3 and left and right:
                for c in range(a+1,b): out[r][c]=1
    # Vertical: link aligned endpoints when both have neighboring diagonal arms.
    for c in range(w):
        rs=[r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c]==2]
        for a,b in zip(rs,rs[1:]):
            above = (c>0 and a>0 and grid[a-1][c-1]==2) or (c+1<w and a>0 and grid[a-1][c+1]==2)
            below = (c>0 and b+1<h and grid[b+1][c-1]==2) or (c+1<w and b+1<h and grid[b+1][c+1]==2)
            if b-a>=3 and above and below:
                for r in range(a+1,b): out[r][c]=1
    return out
